**The Mission:** 
 You are the engineer who ships the model, not just the one who trains it. At Blissway, we process 11 million images every single day, running detection, segmentation, classification, embeddings, and re\-identification across everything in the camera’s frame. You will own the full arc: raw sensor data to production inference, dataset curation to deployment monitoring, cloud to edge. This role is for the engineer who sees a model sitting in a notebook and feels the itch to put it to the test, or in this case, on the road.
   

  

**The Work**
* Own the Whole Pipeline: You decide which problems are worth solving, then take them from raw sensor data all the way to production: collection, dataset curation, training, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. We wire it all together and run our own servers, so the pipeline is yours end to end.
* Real Hardware in the Real World: This is the part that makes us special. We own the devices in the field. This means any idea you have can actually get built and tested on real roads.
* Vision at Real Scale: We process 11 million images every single day, running detection, segmentation, classification, embeddings, and re\-identification across everything in the frame: vehicles, license plates, wheels, even lane markings. Beyond images, we have multiple other sensors on the road pulling in different data making the problem space wide open. At this volume, the right model can drastically improve accuracy and cut cost at the same time.
* Classical CV to Custom SOTA: Our toolbox spans the full range, from traditional computer vision algorithms to custom\-trained state\-of\-the\-art models (detection, segmentation, embeddings, classifiers). You pick the right tool, and when nothing off\-the\-shelf is good enough, you train your own.
* Build the Best Models That Exist: We read the papers, go to the conferences, and hold our work to the current frontier. ML has become essential to Blissway over the past year, and this team is where that bet gets made real.
* Edge and Cloud: Most of our compute lives in the cloud where power is effectively unlimited. We're now pushing more inference onto the roadside hardware itself, a completely different problem: the models have to be fast, small, and power\-efficient without giving up accuracy. You'll work both sides of that constraint.


**Requirements**
* Experience: 2 to 6 years of software engineering with a focus on machine learning and/or computer vision. We want someone with true end\-to\-end experience: you've taken models from raw data to production and owned what happens after they ship.

 We're a small team, which means a more deliberate interview process than you might be used to. In exchange, you get real autonomy from day one, direct access to the people setting technical direction, and work that ships to real roads in weeks, not quarters.
   

  

**The Process:** 
 We hire software engineers in cohorts. Rather than evaluate candidates on a rolling basis, we collect applications over a two\-week window and assess everyone together. This allows us to make fair, considered comparisons and move the strongest candidates through the process efficiently and fairly.
   

  

 The process has five stages:
   

  

* Application Review: We (a human) read every application carefully at the close of the approximately two\-week window.
* Ezra: A brief AI\-assisted screening to make sure we're a mutual fit before investing more of your time. Think of this as a way to augment your application.
* Screening Interview: A focused conversation to understand your background and motivations.
* Technical Interview: A deeper evaluation of your skills and how you think through problems.
* Experience Interview: A conversation about how you've worked and what you've built.

**About Us**
**MintMCP** 
 helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.
   

  

 Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.
   

  

 We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

 We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. We are building an entire company operating system around them, and you will help build it.

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Robotics Software Engineer to design, build, and integrate software systems that power autonomous robots and robotic platforms. In this role you will work across the full robotics software stack, from low\-level sensor integration and motion planning to high\-level perception and behavioral systems. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep working knowledge of robotics frameworks, real\-time systems, and sensor fusion. In this role you will work closely with cross\-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well\-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop robotics software in C\+\+ and Python, with strong attention to real\-time performance and reliability
* Design and integrate sensor data pipelines including cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, and proprioceptive sensors
* Implement perception, localization, and mapping algorithms including SLAM and sensor fusion, integrating data from cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, and other sensors into robust real\-world state estimation
* Develop motion planning, control, and trajectory generation algorithms that respect kinematic and dynamic constraints while delivering smooth, predictable, and safe robot behavior in production environments
* Build behavioral systems using state machines, behavior trees, or task planners
* Integrate ROS / ROS 2 frameworks with custom hardware and embedded systems
* Implement safety\-critical patterns including watchdogs, fault detection, and safe stops
* Build simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim) for development and testing
* Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, and ML engineers, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards
* Design and execute field tests, including data collection and post\-test analysis
* Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time
* Mentor and coach junior and mid\-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time
* Continuously evaluate emerging robotics technologies and frameworks, assessing maturity, fit for purpose, and total cost of ownership, and make grounded recommendations on which to adopt, pilot, or defer based on real engineering needs

* Strong programming skills in C\+\+ and Python
* Hands\-on experience with ROS or ROS 2 in production projects
* Solid experience with at least one of perception, localization, motion planning, or control
* Familiarity with sensor fusion and Kalman/particle filter techniques
* Experience with simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo)
* Strong debugging skills in real\-time and concurrent systems
* Excellent communication and documentation skills
* Experience supporting field tests and hardware integration


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced degree in Robotics or related field
* Exposure to autonomous vehicles, drones, or industrial automation
* Experience with safety\-critical software (ISO 26262, IEC 61508\)
* Familiarity with ML\-based perception pipelines
* Open\-source contributions in robotics

**Job Description**
 This role focuses on designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise data infrastructure to support advanced analytics across engineering and business teams. The Data Engineer builds scalable data pipelines, ensures data integrity and accessibility, and enables reporting and dashboards that transform raw data into actionable insights. The position supports enterprise data architecture and governance, particularly across cloud platforms and business intelligence tools, while working closely with cross\-functional stakeholders in a fast\-paced engineering environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data storage solutions to support enterprise analytics and reporting.
* Integrate data from multiple sources, including databases, APIs, and enterprise platforms, into centralized data warehouses or data lakes.
* Transform raw data into structured, analytics\-ready datasets that support dashboards, reports, and advanced analytics use cases.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity through robust validation, quality control, and monitoring processes.
* Optimize data pipelines and storage solutions for performance, scalability, and reliability in cloud and on\-premises environments.
* Support data architecture governance by identifying and maintaining authoritative sources of truth (ASOT) for key data domains.
* Enable and manage data replication, transformation, and synchronization across enterprise platforms such as AWS and Power BI.
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical data solutions.
* Develop and maintain data models and documentation that support enterprise reporting and analytics.
* Troubleshoot data issues, diagnose root causes, and implement corrective actions to maintain system performance and data quality.
* Work cross\-functionally with engineering and stakeholder teams to align data solutions with program and business objectives.
* Apply strong analytical skills, including statistics, probability, and mathematical modeling, to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum activities and contribute to continuous improvement of data engineering processes and practices.
* Manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining high standards of quality and organization.


**Essential Skills**
* Proven experience in data engineering and data infrastructure design, including pipelines, data warehouses, and databases.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with Oracle databases.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS and Redshift for cloud\-based data solutions.
* Proficiency with Power BI for data transformation, reporting, and dashboard development.
* Experience in data pipeline development using ETL/ELT tools and frameworks.
* Practical experience with data validation, quality control, and data governance, including familiarity with authoritative sources of truth (ASOT).
* Strong analytical skills, including knowledge of statistics, probability, and mathematical modeling.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with engineering teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within team environments.

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities in data and system environments.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast\-paced setting.
* High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
* Experience developing data requirements and data models to support analytics and reporting.


**Additional Skills \& Qualifications**
* Experience with Midas, SSAS, Alation, and Dataiku for data management and analytics.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Anduril's Space team is dedicated to expanding our AI\-powered capabilities into the final frontier, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Control, and Command and Control for U.S. military and allied partners. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.
   

  

 The Lattice for Space C2 (LSC2\) team owns the ground command\-and\-control platform — the services that interface directly with radios, ground\-station networks, and flight computers to execute satellite missions in production.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As a Software Engineer on Space Ground Software, you will build, deploy, and operate the command\-and\-control software that flies real space missions — the ground\-side services that plan missions, command spacecraft, ingest and serve telemetry, drive antennas and ground stations, and keep deployed satellite systems running in production. You will develop modular capabilities on top of the Anduril Lattice software platform to support DoD and IC customers across the space domain, architecting Space C2 services, infrastructure, algorithms, and integrations that span both orbital and ground systems. The Anduril Space C2 capability development will involve integration with legacy systems that have been part of our nation's critical defense for decades, as well as new space systems being added to the set of orbital and ground\-based capabilities.
   

  

 We work with mission partners and operators to deploy reliable and robust capabilities on operationally\-relevant fielding timelines to meet complex challenges across the DOD and IC.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own software solutions end\-to\-end — from API/proto design through deployment to production operation — and be on the hook when they run in front of customers
* Build and operate backend services across the Space C2 stack (Go, gRPC/Protobuf): command \& telemetry, mission and plan management, ground\-station and antenna brokering, space\-to\-ground protocol stacks, file transfer, and access control
* Write and evolve protobuf API contracts, coordinating interface changes across teams
* Deploy and run services in secure government cloud on containers/Kubernetes, and participate in on\-call and incident response for live missions
* Integrate with spacecraft and ground infrastructure — software\-defined radios, antenna pointing, ground\-station providers, space\-to\-ground data links, and astrodynamics (orbit propagation, maneuver planning, satellite state)
* Build and run software\-in\-the\-loop (SITL) simulation to validate end\-to\-end operations before live passes
* Integrate with legacy systems to unlock 21st\-century capabilities
* Review your teammates' code and uphold a high quality bar — rigorous, high\-volume code review is a core part of the job on this team
* Collaborate across multiple teams to plan, build, and test complex functionality
* Create and analyze metrics for debugging and monitoring; triage issues, root cause failures, and coordinate next\-steps
* Partner with end\-users to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints


**Required Qualifications**
* Strong engineering background from industry or school, ideally in areas/fields such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics
* 4\+ years building backend and distributed systems, primarily in a systems language (Go, Rust, or C\+\+), with networked services using gRPC/Protobuf — and comfortable working primarily in Go
* Experience shipping and operating production services on containers/Kubernetes, with real CI/CD and cloud deployment — you've run what you've built, not just written it
* Experience integrating software with physical systems — hardware control, embedded interfaces, protocol implementation, or real\-time data pipelines
* Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and detailed requirements, and to solve complex technical problems with little oversight
* Strong collaboration and code\-review discipline, with clear communication and good documentation/training habits
* A desire to work on critical software that has a real\-world impact
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Space/aerospace domain experience: telemetry \& commanding, ground stations and antenna systems, RF/waveform/link\-layer, orbital mechanics, or GNC
* Experience with space C2 software systems and spacecraft operations
* Experience with CCSDS protocols (TM/TC framing, CFDP, virtual channels) or similar layered communication standards
* Experience with binary protocol parsing — deserializing wire formats, implementing framing layers, or working with annotation\-driven codecs
* Previous exposure to software\-defined radios, RF modems, or satellite communication equipment
* Experience with deployment and infrastructure\-as\-code tooling such as Kubernetes, FluxCD, Helm, Terraform, or Nix, and government cloud (e.g., Azure Gov)

Quest Defense is seeking a highly motivated Data Scientist to support data\-driven program execution, operational reporting, engineering analytics, and decision support for safety and mission\-critical aerospace programs.
 



  





 The Data Scientist will work with program managers, engineers, technical teams, customer stakeholders, and business leaders to collect, structure, transform, analyze, visualize, and communicate data that supports delivery performance, resource planning, schedule execution, financial tracking, operational improvement, and engineering decision\-making.
 



  





 This role requires someone who can operate in a modern data environment, work through imperfect and disconnected data sources, build repeatable data pipelines, improve data hygiene, and translate complex information into clear insights, dashboards, reports, and recommendations. The ideal candidate has strong Python skills, experience with Dataiku or similar data platforms, exposure to AWS or comparable cloud environments, and the ability to present data in a way that helps leaders and technical teams make better decisions.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Collect, clean, organize, transform, and analyze data from multiple business, engineering, operational, and program sources.
* Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines that support repeatable reporting, analytics, dashboards, and decision\-support products.
* Work in Dataiku or similar data science / data engineering platforms to prepare datasets, develop workflows, automate analysis, and support scalable analytics.
* Use Python to clean, transform, analyze, and automate data processes.
* Support data integration, data transformation, and data hygiene across structured, semi\-structured, and manually maintained data sources.
* Develop dashboards, trackers, reports, and visualizations that support program execution, customer reviews, operating reviews, and leadership visibility.
* Analyze trends, gaps, risks, anomalies, and performance indicators related to schedule, cost, staffing, utilization, delivery, engineering workflows, and operational performance.
* Partner with program managers, delivery leaders, engineers, supply chain, quality, and customer stakeholders to understand data needs and define useful reporting outputs.
* Validate data accuracy, identify inconsistencies, and recommend improvements to source data, reporting logic, and business processes.
* Support development of repeatable analytics processes, templates, standard work, data models, and documentation.
* Assist with ad hoc analysis, scenario planning, forecasting, executive reporting, and root cause analysis.
* Communicate findings clearly through concise visualizations, summaries, recommendations, and executive\-ready presentations.
* Help improve data discipline, reporting cadence, data governance, and visibility across programs.
* Contribute to the development of advanced analytics, automation, predictive models, and AI\-enabled workflows where appropriate.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in data science, data analytics, data engineering, business intelligence, program analytics, operations analytics, or a related role.
* Strong Python skills, including experience with data manipulation, transformation, analysis, and automation.
* Experience with SQL and working with relational or structured datasets.
* Experience building reports, dashboards, or visualizations using tools of any sort.
* Experience cleaning, joining, transforming, and validating data from multiple sources.
* Understanding of data pipelines, ETL/ELT concepts, and repeatable data workflows.
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends, communicate findings, and translate business questions into analytical outputs.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, data quality, and data hygiene.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional technical and non\-technical teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced program or engineering environment.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with Dataiku or similar data science, analytics, or workflow automation platforms.
* Experience with AWS data services or cloud\-based analytics environments.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar data platforms.
* Experience developing, maintaining, or optimizing data pipelines.
* Experience with machine learning models, statistical analysis, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, or forecasting.
* Exposure to natural language processing, AI/LLM integration, or agentic AI workflows.
* Experience supporting aerospace, defense, manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, quality, or program management environments.
* Familiarity with program management metrics, schedule tracking, cost tracking, utilization, staffing, risk management, operational KPIs, or engineering workflow analytics.
* Experience working with customer\-facing teams or supporting executive\-level reporting.
* Ability to create repeatable reporting processes and improve data quality over time.
* Experience with data storytelling, visual management, and executive\-ready presentation of insights.
* Familiarity with controlled data environments, customer systems, export\-controlled information, or compliance\-sensitive reporting.
* Experience working within Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or continuous improvement environments.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strong analytical thinking
* Practical data science judgment
* Data quality and data hygiene discipline
* Python\-based problem solving
* Data transformation and workflow ownership
* Business and operational acumen
* Communication and data storytelling
* Customer focus
* Attention to detail
* Ownership and follow\-through
* Curiosity and technical learning agility
* Ability to operate in ambiguity
* Continuous improvement mindset



  





**Success in This Role Looks Like** 




 A successful Data Scientist will help the team move from disconnected data and manual reporting toward more reliable, repeatable, and actionable analytics. They will provide accurate, timely, and useful information that helps the team understand performance, identify risks, and make better decisions.
 



  





 They will not simply report numbers. They will help explain what the data means, where action may be needed, how the data can be trusted, and how reporting and analytics can become more automated, scalable, and valuable over time.
 



  





 The strongest candidate will combine hands\-on technical ability with practical business judgment: someone who can build the pipeline, clean the data, analyze the result, visualize the story, and communicate the recommendation.

 The Retail Capacity Control team builds large\-scale, high\-availability software systems that power Amazon's supply chain through mathematical modeling, simulations, and data analysis. **Impact**
 As a Data Scientist specializing in geospatial intelligence, you will help power the next generation of final\-mile logistics. This role will develop advanced models and data systems that leverage location, routing, traffic, and spatial signals to improve delivery success, reduce operational costs, and create a better experience for customers and drivers.
   

  

 In this role you will work with large\-scale GPS traces, mapping data and geospatial datasets. You will collaborate with product ,managers, logistic operators and software engineers to turn models into real\-world systems. You will design experiments and translate complex geospatial insights into actionable operational decisions.
   

  

****What You’ll Need to Be Successful****
* MS or PhD in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or other quantitative fields
* 2\+ years of experience with geospatial data (ex. GPS traces, spatial indexing systems, or routing systems)
* Strong understanding of predictive modeling, feature engineering, experimentation and causal inference
* Strong Python skills with experience in libraries such as: pandas, scikit\-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow
* Ability to work with large datasets and distributed systems (ex. Spark, BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.)

**About Pathros** 





 Pathros is building access\-path intelligence for modern identity security. We help security teams, developers, and fast\-moving companies understand how access actually flows across their systems, especially the risky inherited permissions, hidden privilege chains, and identity relationships that traditional IAM tools often miss.
 




  






 Our mission is simple: make life easier, one CISO at a time. We believe security should not be buried in dashboards, vague alerts, or manual audits. It should give teams exact answers, strong evidence, and practical ways to reduce risk without slowing down the business.
 




  






 At Pathros, we value precision, integrity, speed, taste, and deep ownership. We are performance\-driven and committed to building tools that help both enterprise security leaders and individual engineers do their best work.
 




  





**Role Overview** 





 Joining Pathros means joining a small, ambitious team building foundational infrastructure for the future of identity security.
